style: Original 4:3 photorealistic food, pale oak, beige linen, warm side light, same stainless pan and ivory bowls; no text, logos, people, hands or collage
first: Shredded cabbage, whole eggs, panko, small lined bowl and empty pan
stages: One raw egg freshly cracked onto a thin bed of coarse panko on trimmed food-safe baking parchment inside the small shallow white bowl. Intact round orange-yellow yolk centered in translucent egg white, panko visible around it. Two separate ingredients only, no additional batter or flour. No broken eggshell touching the food.

The same raw egg on parchment inside the small shallow white bowl is now covered completely with a light even layer of dry coarse panko crumbs, a low flattened egg shape with only a faint raised yolk mound, not a croquette or bread roll. A spoon with remaining panko rests beside bowl. No raw yolk exposed, no flour.

The same small 18 cm deep stainless steel pan with straight black handle on an ELECTRIC stove, containing a shallow 2 cm depth of clear neutral oil warming. A frying thermometer clipped at side with display facing away, no readable digits. No egg in pan yet, no smoke, no gas flame, clean dry utensils nearby.

Close cooking photograph: one flat panko-coated egg beginning to fry on a SMALL neatly trimmed piece of parchment in the same small stainless pan of shallow oil on electric stove. Parchment sits underneath the egg only, with no large tall corners, its edges safely inside the pan. Gentle bubbles around egg, a little oil on its top. A long slotted metal spoon supports it from beneath. No hands, no flames, no violent splashes.

The same pan on electric stove: one oval flat egg katsu frying with a golden coarse panko crust facing upward, PAPER NOW REMOVED ENTIRELY. The crust is golden brown around the whole egg and the egg is cooking through. A slotted spoon rests at edge to turn the egg. Not a meat cutlet, not a breaded hard-boiled egg ball, no visible yolk, no smoking oil.

Freshly fried egg katsu draining on a small wire rack over a tray on the pale oak counter. Four separate flat oval panko-crusted eggs in warm golden brown tones, realistic uneven crumb texture. The same small stainless steel pan with black handle is in the background. A little shredded cabbage nearby on a clean plate. No paper under the eggs on the rack.

Appetizing finished hero photograph: one golden panko-crusted flat fried egg katsu cut once in half to show a fully SET yellow yolk and opaque cooked white inside a thin crisp breadcrumb crust, with a small mound of finely shredded fresh white cabbage on a shallow ivory plate. Another whole flat egg katsu behind on separate plate. Firm golden yellow center, NOT runny, no liquid yolk flowing. Warm natural side light, beige linen, same kitchen, photo for recipe cover. No sauce, no rice, no extra garnish ingredients, no hands or words.
cover_correction: Flat fried egg katsu with firm yolk, not a breaded hard-boiled egg
